purpose: Preserve the completed semantic decisions for the four declared groups so a final relevant-occurrence ledger can reference their producer/consumer boundaries. This document is not an occurrence census, CI receipt, archive inspection, or acceptance certificate.

method.sourceAccess: GitHub MCP read-only source access at the pinned commit
method.materialization: A documentation blob only; no source edit, commit, tree, reference, workflow or CI mutation is part of this observation.
method.analysis: Follow actual entrypoints, installed composition, request parsers, runtime consumers and effects. Interpret project/profile/directory names by their dataflow rather than by occurrence counts.
method.previousReviewReused: The prior Teams -> Decisions/C17 -> Atlas review was closed separately and is not presented as new coverage here.
method.readExtentRule: A file listed with selected ranges was reviewed only for the stated boundary; its entire implementation is not claimed as reviewed.

conclusion.rationale: In these reviewed paths Microsoft corporate selection is an explicit installation/tenant/Team intent re-admitted by the installed server. Project/Location paths retained for local-operator discovery or personal Orchestra execution do not select the active Microsoft profile. Packaged development prompts and skills have identified personal/local consumers and do not create Microsoft admission.

execution.note: Every test entry below describes existing source assertions. No test was executed in this review. Earlier chat statements about UI CI success are intentionally not converted into execution evidence in this blob; root may attach separately verified execution.

globalGateClaims.explanation: Four semantic groups do not classify a repository-wide 23k occurrence universe. No global zero count, signed qualification, or production-delivery acceptance is inferred from this document.

groups.decision: The installed Microsoft web entry chooses the Teams shell before the personal Orchestra server/project path. It requests current installation metadata and then an explicit selection or Team context; it does not select a corporate profile from repo, cwd, worktree, Dock profile or saved personal server.

groups.decision: Public Schema/Protocol/generated-client fields are transport shapes. The installed/server parser reads the original raw URL and separates corporate current/installation selectors from local-operator ids/location selectors before any result is returned.

Only Sucafina discovery endpoint is registered in this Protocol group; it grants no admission.

Generated input/output types preserve discovery DTO branches; these are not admission capabilities.

groups.decision: Microsoft composition does not load the generic local host context. Its context handler takes the Teams parser branch whenever teamTenantId exists, even if a client omits contractRevision. Remaining legacy Microsoft DTO literals do not provide an observed fallback into corporate authority.

groups.decision: The reviewed packer builds declared native-seat skill trees and Maestro playbooks as content. Its source/extraction paths are content placement, not Team selection. Its runtime consumers belong to personal/local Orchestra composition, and the reviewed Microsoft installation does not load the generic native host contribution.
